title: Track draft-ietf-jmap-metadata -02 to -04
description: crate-jmap cites draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 in 140 places (metadata-types/server/client, WithMetadata filters in mail/sharing/chat clients, AGENTS.md). -03 and then -04 (posted 2026-10-19, datatracker) are out. Diff -02 vs -04 (rfcdiff / datatracker), list wire changes (properties, capability, filter conditions, SetErrors), file child beads for each needed code change, then refresh citations. Scene draft already moved to -04 (jmap-chat-spec).
notes: Batch 8b review, -04 doc drift left after lu95.1-.7: (1) crate-jmap-metadata-types/README.md:13-14 still give the -02 rule (is_registered_namespace 'US-ASCII letters', is_vendor_namespace 'printable-ASCII labels'); -04 §2.1 requires lowercase ('lowercase US-ASCII letters'; 'Domain-name identifiers MUST be in lowercase') and the code rejects uppercase. (2) crate-jmap-metadata-server/PLAN.md:40 value_depth still says scalars/empty/flat objects are depth 1; code and -04 §2.1 use scalar 0, [] 0. (3) PLAN.md:46 metadata_text_contains still 'case-insensitive substring' (-02 §3.5); code is i;unicode-casemap (RFC 5051). (4) crate-jmap-metadata-server/README.md:71-72 says updatedProperties is null when ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges is true; -04 §3.3 lets Mailbox/changes list count properties and makes the field always present when the metadata capability is in using (disagrees with changes.rs module doc). (5) crate-jmap-metadata-types/src/lib.rs:9 now says '-04 eliminates the standalone Metadata object' (a blanket s/-02/-04/); -02 removed it, and crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/lib.rs:3 still says -02. Suggested: 'Since -02, the draft has no standalone Metadata object type'.
